episodes.title: Mica Miller: 7 CRAZY Details Netflix Missed
episodes.description:
Netflix's Death of the Pastor's Wife missed A LOT. JP Miller is now under federal indictment for cyberstalking Mica Miller and lying to federal investigators, but he actually admitted to a lot of his alleged abuse against Mica Miller, and that's just detail #3. Here are the 7 things the documentary didn't tell you about the circumstances surrounding Mica Miller's death, JP Miller and his father’s dark history, and the crazy sermon JP Miller preached the day after Mica Miller died that Solid Rock Church deleted.

Mica Miller died on April 27, 2024, two days after serving her husband, Pastor JP Miller of Solid Rock Church in Myrtle Beach, SC, with divorce papers. Her death was ruled a suicide, but a pattern of coercive control, stalking, and abuse documented in a December 2025 federal indictment tells a story that Netflix's docuseries only scratched the surface of. 

In this video, we break down 7 crazy and important details missing from "Death of the Pastor's Wife," including JP Miller's father's history, the missing power-of-attorney documents, JP's own recorded mental health confessions, the sermon that disappeared from the church's channels the same week Mica died, and more.

episodes.title: Why is Mica Miller's Church Hiding This Sermon? | Part 3 | #justiceformica
episodes.description:

Solid Rock Church at Market Common Church in Myrtle Beach, SC deleted this sermon shortly after the news of Mica Miller's death went nationwide. I believe they did that to hide Pastor JP Miller's body language and behavior in this sermon and to hide from further scrutiny.

Thanks to a whistleblower, however, we have the full deleted sermon. Please join me as I walk through the sermon JP Miller preached the morning he announced his estranged wife's death. We'll look specifically for red flags of deception, manipulation, and other behavior that might shed some light on the tragic death of Mica Miller.
